missingOpsRanked.desc: All allies except the caster each attack one chosen enemy with their default skill (team-wide beatdown). A2 A3 clause 3. Recurs across Glorious Pallas A1, Mavara A1, Michelangelo A4 — build once.

A passive reactive trigger that fires when an ally dies — here specifically when the champion's LAST living ally is killed (champion becomes sole survivor), placing self-buffs in response. Same missing class as the on-kill / on-resist reactive triggers noted in the guide. Both Passive clauses' PLACE_BUFF payloads are expressible and have valid consumers (Increase SPD, Block Damage) but cannot fire without this trigger op.

Probabilistically re-executes an entire attack sequence (all hits + per-hit riders such as Turn Meter drain), and can chain. Thor A1 = 20% chance. Distinct from the existing extraHitChance flag, which adds a single bare hit and does not re-apply riders.

Attack damage bypasses the enemy's [Unkillable] buff (can bring a target below 1 HP / kill through it). The ignore_block_damage and ignore_shield flags already exist; an ignore_unkillable flag does not. Thor A2 needs it (paired with Block-Damage ignore).

A named self counter that (1) increments on every damage instance dealt (cap 10), (2) drives a counter-scaled self DMG% bonus (+3% per stack, max +30%), (3) fires a reactive AoE attack + [Stun] when it reaches the cap, and (4) resets to 0 afterward. Covers all four Thor A4 clauses; a general counter/threshold-reactive primitive reusable by other counter-passive champions.

Model [Decrease RES] / permanent RES reduction so it lowers the target's effective RES and thus raises the attacking team's debuff-land chance. Currently RES reduction has no consumer, so Thor A3's permanent -10%→-50% RES shred is inert (and likely other champions' too).

Remove N random buff(s) from enemies at a chance; no side gains them — distinct from STEAL_BUFF (caster takes them) and CLEANSE (ally-side debuff removal). A2 removes 1 random buff from all enemies @75%.
Reactive: when an ally under a [Shield] is attacked, reflect a % of the damage absorbed by that Shield back to the attacker. Passive-triggered per hit; not the placed [Reflect Damage] buff.
Reactive: heal the attacked shielded ally by a % of the damage absorbed by their [Shield]. Damage-based reactive heal (sibling of Hordin-style damage-based self-heal), gated to Shield-damage events.
Passive: redirect a fixed % (20%) of all incoming damage the caster receives onto allies, spread equally across them. A damage-share/redistribution mechanic with no existing op.
Self-heal scaled off damage inflicted (not caster MaxHP/flat). A1 heals 20% of each hit's damage; HEAL op only supports pct-of-MaxHP/flat. Recurs: Hordin.
Exchange current HP values between caster and target (A3). Distinct from Mavara equalize-HP (swap vs average-to-midpoint); also gates the A3 DEF-ignore branch.
Reactive trigger firing when the champion loses >=30% MaxHP from an enemy skill within a single turn (passive Active Effect); would drive an existing DECREASE_COOLDOWN.
Reactive counterattack with default skill triggered each time an enemy is healed by a skill, capped once per turn (passive Passive Effect).
Force an existing ally buff (here one random [Continuous Heal]) to tick immediately — sustain acceleration. Mirror of DEBUFF_ACTIVATION but for ally buffs; DEBUFF_ACTIVATION is enemy-DoT-only. (A1)
Decrease ALL allies' skill cooldowns by N turns (optionally excluding the caster). Existing DECREASE_COOLDOWN op targets the caster's own skills only; the ally-facing recipient is unmodelled. (A2)
Reactive passive that intercepts a fatal hit on any ally and keeps them alive at 1 HP, with de-dup and dead-caster guards. Distinct from the pre-placed [Unkillable] buff. (A4)
Set a champion's HP to the team's average HP level (chained after PREVENT_DEATH here). Recurs: Mavara. (A4)

When a single-target hit kills its target, route the overkill (surplus) damage onto all remaining enemies as a follow-up attack (A2 Staff of Wonder; the splash also carries the skill's 50% DEF-ignore).

Champion revives ITSELF a fixed number of turns after being killed, restoring a set HP% and Turn Meter% (A4). Distinct from REVIVE, which brings back dead ALLIES; requires a delayed on-death reactive-trigger scheduler.
Per-skill flag that forces an attack's damage to be non-critical regardless of C.RATE (A2 'This attack cannot be critical').

Consumer for [Fear]/[True Fear]: a Feared enemy has a chance to fail its turn/action ([True Fear] = always fails). Absent from the Consumer Registry, so EVERY [True Fear] Fabian places (A1, A2, passive) is currently inert — this is his entire kit identity and the single highest-value gap.
Turn Meter steal: drain the enemy's TM AND grant the drained amount to the caster. REDUCE_TURN_METER only drains, so the self-gain half of A1's per-hit 10% steal is unmodelled.

Reactive trigger that re-activates one of the caster's skills whenever an enemy under a specified debuff ([Fear]/[True Fear]) successfully uses a skill — with a team-level once-per-activation dedup (A2 [Passive Effect]).
Reactive trigger that fires an effect whenever an enemy is revived — with a team-level once-per dedup across multiple copies (Ghost With The Most passive).

drafts.summary: Decomposed Thor (Legendary, Magic) into 4 recipes / 15 clauses. MODELLED: A1 2-hit ATK attack + per-hit -10% Turn Meter drain; A2 AoE ricochet with +25%/hit escalating damage (dynamicScaler) and [Block Damage] ignore; A3 AoE ATK + self [Increase ATK] 50% + AoE [Decrease Speed] 30% @75%. INERT/DEFERRED leaks caught: A3 self [Increase C.DMG] (no consumer), A3 permanent -10% Decrease RES (no consumer — RES reduction not modelled). NEEDS-OP mechanics: A1 20% full-attack repeat (REPEAT_ATTACK, re-applies riders — distinct from extraHitChance); A2 [Unkillable]-ignore flag (Block-Damage ignore exists, Unkillable does not); and the entire A4 Thunder-counter passive (accumulate on damage, counter-scaled self DMG%, threshold reactive AoE+Stun at 10, reset). A2 ricochet bonus + ignores are boss-excluded (condition modelled). A4 [Stun] payload is registry-consumable but gated on the unmodelled counter trigger.

clauses.consumer: Increase ATK — read ✓ (boosts this same skill's AoE hit)

drafts.summary: Underpriest Brogni is a Shield-centric support. Two clauses are cleanly modelled by existing ops (A1 HP Burn, A3 Increase ATK + Shield, A2 Cleanse), and BOOST_SHIELD covers both the A3 grant (caster-MaxHP-scaled) and the A2 augment (damage-scaled). Three mechanics have no op: enemy buff-strip (A2), and the passive's paired reactive Shield-damage reflect + reactive Shield-damage heal. [Block Debuffs] (A3) is placed but INERT — not in the Consumer Registry. The 'Shield cannot be removed' flag and the passive's single-activation dedup are attribute/gate clauses with no op. Nothing was dropped: 12 clauses across 4 skills, each either modelled or deferred with a reason.

drafts.summary: Donatello is a Magic Legendary SUPPORT/sustain enabler — no debuffs, all value is ally-facing (heal, cleanse, Increase SPD, Continuous Heal, Strengthen, TM fill, cooldown reduction) plus a TMNT-faction passive (join-attack + team-wide death-prevention/HP-equalize). Of 18 clauses: 10 are modelled ops (2 attacks, 1 HEAL, 1 CLEANSE, 1 FILL_TURN_METER, 3 PLACE_BUFF of registry-read buffs, plus the two ACQUIRE targets folded into the attacks); 8 are deferred. The deferred set drives 5 op gaps: BUFF_ACTIVATION (A1 Continuous-Heal early tick), ally-facing cooldown reduction (A2 — existing DECREASE_COOLDOWN is own-only), and the whole A4 passive trio JOIN_ATTACK / PREVENT_DEATH-keep-at-1HP / EQUALIZE_HP. Every placed buff (Increase SPD, Continuous Heal, Strengthen) IS in the Consumer Registry, so none are inert — the leaks here are missing OPS, not inert buffs. Critical decomposition note: A1's "instantly activates one random [Continuous Heal]" is activation, NOT a Continuous Heal placement (he places CH on A3, not A1).

clauses.text: Attacks 1 enemy.
clauses.effect: single attack hit (ACQUIRE_TARGETS single, then one hit)

clauses.text: Heals all allies by 5% of this Champion’s MAX HP.
clauses.effect: heal 5% of caster MAX HP (no acc-check)

clauses.text: Instantly activates one random [Continuous Heal] buff on all allies.
clauses.effect: force one random already-present [Continuous Heal] buff to tick immediately (sustain acceleration)
clauses.consumer: none (no op) — Continuous Heal itself IS a registry buff, but this clause consumes/accelerates an existing one, it does not place it
clauses.condition: only fires on allies who already carry a [Continuous Heal] buff
clauses.deferReason: needs op: BUFF_ACTIVATION — force an existing ally [Continuous Heal] to tick now. Activation ≠ placement (Policy #12): Donatello does NOT place Continuous Heal on A1 (he places it on A3). DEBUFF_ACTIVATION is enemy-DoT-only, so this ally-buff activation has no op.

clauses.text: Attacks all enemies.
clauses.effect: AoE attack hit (ACQUIRE_TARGETS all_enemies, then one hit each)

clauses.text: Decreases the cooldowns of all allies' skills, except this Champion's, by 2 turns.
clauses.effect: -2 turns on every skill cooldown of each ally (excludes caster)
clauses.consumer: cooldown state (ally-facing — NOT covered by current op)
clauses.condition: excludes this Champion's own skills
clauses.deferReason: needs op: ally-facing cooldown reduction. The existing DECREASE_COOLDOWN op is scoped to the caster's OWN skills; decreasing ALL allies' cooldowns by N (except caster) is a different recipient the current op does not model — crediting it as modelled would over-credit.

clauses.text: This skill's cooldown cannot be decreased or reset.
clauses.effect: marks A2's own cooldown immune to reduction/reset
clauses.condition: self-property guard
clauses.deferReason: skill-property guard, not a placement — no op. Prevents this A2 from being sped up by any cooldown-reduction/reset source. Low sim impact (a self-limiter, not a delivered effect).

clauses.text: Places a 30% [Increase SPD] buff on all allies for 2 turns.
clauses.effect: [Increase SPD] 30% 2t (no acc-check)

clauses.text: Removes all debuffs from all allies.
clauses.effect: remove ALL debuffs from each ally

clauses.text: Places a 15% [Continuous Heal] buff ... on all allies for 2 turns.
clauses.effect: [Continuous Heal] 15% 2t (heals bearer 15% of ITS OWN MaxHP per turn) (no acc-check)
clauses.scalingSource: n-a (per-tick heal scales off each bearer's MaxHP, not caster's)

clauses.text: and a 25% [Strengthen] buff on all allies for 2 turns.
clauses.effect: [Strengthen] 25% 2t (25% damage reduction) (no acc-check)

clauses.text: Also fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20%.
clauses.effect: +20% Turn Meter to each ally

clauses.text: [Passive Effect] Whenever this Champion attacks, any ally Leonardos, Donatellos, Michelangelos, and Raphaels will join in that attack.
clauses.effect: named TMNT allies each perform an extra attack (their default skill) joining Donatello's attack
clauses.condition: fires whenever this Champion attacks; only ally Leonardo / Donatello / Michelangelo / Raphael join (faction/name-gated)
clauses.deferReason: needs op: JOIN_ATTACK (recurs: Glorious Pallas A1, Mavara A1, Michelangelo A4). Trigger cadence = per Donatello attack.

clauses.text: [Active Effect] Whenever an ally is about to receive a fatal hit, this Champion prevents that ally’s death and keeps them alive with 1 HP.
clauses.effect: intercept a fatal hit on any ally; survivor left at 1 HP (Unkillable-like, but reactive/passive and applied to the struck ally, not pre-placed)
clauses.condition: triggers only when an ally is about to take a lethal hit
clauses.deferReason: needs op: PREVENT_DEATH — reactive fatal-hit interception keeping the ally at 1 HP. Distinct from the [Unkillable] buff (which is a pre-placed registry buff); this is an always-on passive with no placed buff to read.

clauses.text: Then equalizes that ally’s HP to the average HP level of the team.
clauses.effect: set the rescued ally's HP% to the team's average HP% (chained after the death-prevention)
clauses.condition: only after the fatal-hit prevention above fires
clauses.deferReason: needs op: EQUALIZE_HP (recurs: Mavara). Order-dependent 'Then' — runs immediately after PREVENT_DEATH.

clauses.text: If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate.
clauses.effect: de-duplication guard — only one copy of this passive's Active Effect resolves per fatal hit
clauses.condition: multiple team members carry I Got You Bro!
clauses.deferReason: meta-restriction on the PREVENT_DEATH op, not a standalone placement — no op. Prevents double-triggering when two TMNT carry the passive.

clauses.text: This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.
clauses.effect: the Active Effect is disabled for a dead instance of Donatello (duplicate copies do not proxy for it)
clauses.condition: this particular Champion is dead
clauses.deferReason: meta-restriction gating the PREVENT_DEATH op's availability — no op. A dead Donatello grants no protection even if a duplicate is alive.

needsOps.whatItDoes: Force an existing ally buff (here one random [Continuous Heal]) to tick immediately — sustain acceleration. Mirror of DEBUFF_ACTIVATION but for ally buffs; DEBUFF_ACTIVATION is enemy-DoT-only. (A1)
Decrease ALL allies' skill cooldowns by N turns (optionally excluding the caster). Existing DECREASE_COOLDOWN op targets the caster's own skills only; the ally-facing recipient is unmodelled. (A2)

Named/faction-gated allies (Leonardo/Donatello/Michelangelo/Raphael) join the caster's attack with their default skill whenever the caster attacks. Recurs: Glorious Pallas A1, Mavara A1, Michelangelo A4. (A4)
Reactive passive that intercepts a fatal hit on any ally and keeps them alive at 1 HP, with de-dup and dead-caster guards. Distinct from the pre-placed [Unkillable] buff. (A4)
Set a champion's HP to the team's average HP level (chained after PREVENT_DEATH here). Recurs: Mavara. (A4)

drafts.summary: Sun Wukong (Legendary, Spirit) decomposed. Modelled: A1 single-target hit + [Stun] (Stun is in the Consumer Registry), A2 single hit with 50% DEF-ignore modifier, A3 AoE hit + STEAL_BUFF. Deferred/inert: A2 surplus-splash on kill (no op), A2 no-crit flag (no op), A2 [Sheep] (not in Consumer Registry — inert), A3 [Block Buffs] (explicitly no consumer — inert), A4 entire self-revive (REVIVE is ally-only; self-revive is a distinct unbuilt mechanic per policy #21). Three op gaps flagged: SURPLUS_DAMAGE, SELF_REVIVE, CANNOT_CRIT.

clauses.condition: resolves before the attack (phase before_attack)

clauses.condition: after this Champion has been killed
clauses.deferReason: needs op: SELF_REVIVE — REVIVE targets DEAD ALLIES only; a champion reviving ITSELF is a distinct mechanic (policy #21 self-revive ≠ ally-revive) with no op

Per-skill flag that forces an attack's damage to be non-critical regardless of C.RATE (A2 'This attack cannot be critical').

drafts.summary: Lord Entertainer Fabian is a Spirit Legendary whose entire identity is [Fear]/[True Fear] control — and [Fear]/[True Fear] are NOT in the Consumer Registry, so nearly all of his debuff output is currently INERT/deferred. Of his 4 skills: A1 lands damage + Turn Meter steal (drain modelled; self-gain half needs a STEAL_TURN_METER op) with a conditional [True Fear] that is inert. A2 lands damage + a real [Petrification] (consumed) plus an inert [True Fear] AoE, and its [Passive Effect] re-cast is a reactive-on-enemy-skill-use trigger with no op. A3 is the strongest for the engine: AoE damage + decrease-buff-duration (REDUCE_EFFECT_DURATION) + increase-cooldown, plus a conditional Extra Turn. The Ghost With The Most passive is an on-enemy-revive reactive (no op) placing inert [True Fear], plus a modelled self-CLEANSE of hard-CC. Four needsOps flagged, the load-bearing one being a consumer for [Fear]/[True Fear] itself.

clauses.effect: 2 hits, ATK-based attack damage

clauses.effect: -10% Turn Meter per hit (x2 hits = -20%), no acc-check (TM manipulation, not a debuff)
clauses.condition: per hit
clauses.deferReason: drain half is modelled; the STEAL (caster gains the drained amount) has no op — see needsOps STEAL_TURN_METER

clauses.condition: only if the target's Turn Meter is fully depleted
clauses.deferReason: [True Fear] not in Consumer Registry — no engine consumer, inert

clauses.effect: 1 hit, ATK-based attack damage

clauses.effect: [Petrification] 1t acc-check

clauses.effect: [True Fear] 2t @75% acc-check on all OTHER enemies
clauses.condition: excludes the A2 attack target; only enemies not already under [Fear] or [True Fear]
clauses.deferReason: [True Fear] not in Consumer Registry — no engine consumer, inert

clauses.effect: reactive re-cast of A2 (Unwelcome Guest)
clauses.condition: fires when an enemy under [Fear]/[True Fear] successfully uses a skill

clauses.text: If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate.

clauses.condition: multiple champions on the team carry this skill
clauses.deferReason: dedup limiter riding on an already-deferred reactive trigger — no op

clauses.condition: resolves before the attack (feeds the Extra Turn check below)

clauses.effect: 1 Extra Turn
clauses.condition: only if zero buffs remain on the enemy team after the A3 attack resolves
clauses.deferReason: extra-turn op exists but is unwired in several recipes (per vocabulary note) — verify it fires before relying on it

clauses.text: Whenever an enemy is revived, places a [True Fear] debuff on that enemy for 2 turns.
clauses.effect: [True Fear] 2t on the revived enemy
clauses.condition: fires when an enemy is revived
clauses.deferReason: doubly blocked: needs op REACT_ON_ENEMY_REVIVE (no on-enemy-revive trigger), AND [True Fear] has no engine consumer (inert)

clauses.text: If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, this effect will only activate once.
clauses.effect: team-level once-per dedup on the on-revive trigger

clauses.text: Removes any [Stun], [Freeze], [Provoke], [Fear], [True Fear], and [Petrification] debuffs from this Champion before the start of their turn.

needsOps.whatItDoes: Consumer for [Fear]/[True Fear]: a Feared enemy has a chance to fail its turn/action ([True Fear] = always fails). Absent from the Consumer Registry, so EVERY [True Fear] Fabian places (A1, A2, passive) is currently inert — this is his entire kit identity and the single highest-value gap.
Turn Meter steal: drain the enemy's TM AND grant the drained amount to the caster. REDUCE_TURN_METER only drains, so the self-gain half of A1's per-hit 10% steal is unmodelled.

Reactive trigger that re-activates one of the caster's skills whenever an enemy under a specified debuff ([Fear]/[True Fear]) successfully uses a skill — with a team-level once-per-activation dedup (A2 [Passive Effect]).
Reactive trigger that fires an effect whenever an enemy is revived — with a team-level once-per dedup across multiple copies (Ghost With The Most passive).
